scenarios.waitMore: Wait for more data to build a reliable short-term read.
scenarios.label: {{label}} scenario
scenarios.baseNeutral: Base case: consolidation continues between recent support and resistance while momentum stays mixed.
scenarios.baseBullish: Base case: bullish bias persists, but expect pullbacks as price retests recent levels.
scenarios.baseBearish: Base case: bearish bias persists, but short squeezes/pullbacks can occur near support.
scenarios.bullText: Bull case: a sustained break above the recent swing high (resistance) could signal continuation. (Directional read, not a guaranteed forecast.)
scenarios.bearText: Bear case: a sustained break below the recent swing low (support) could open further downside. (Directional read, not a guaranteed forecast.)

analysis.educationalNote: Educational note: this is a deterministic, rule-based read of recent market behavior, not financial advice.
